utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet, but I can check while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’d be helpful, thanks. If you hear anything, let me know and I’ll keep my list ready.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll do that—if I hear any updates, I’ll pass them along right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s sort the donation list and then I’ll help load up the truck.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll sort the list, and you can handle the truck.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely happening, right? Just want to make sure I heard that correctly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it’s happening — I just want to make sure the timing and drop-off details are clear before we say for sure.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — so it’s happening, but the timing and drop-off still need to be confirmed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thank you, Cleo—I always lose track of that sort of thing. Let me know what’s still needed and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details first—what needs fixing and by when?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I haven’t got the full list in front of me. Let me check the repair drive and I’ll send you the details by today.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll wait for the details by today.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can still pitch in—what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Dane — we could use help sorting donations and checking the repair list. If you’re up for it, I’ll point you to the first job.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure thing—point me to the first job and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Gus — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam — could you bring your drill and a few extra screws? I’ll have the rest ready when you get here.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m ready to help keep track of the repair drive — where should I note the location?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Opal — please note it as the neighborhood community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll note the neighborhood community center parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet, but I’m happy to pass along anything I learn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Tess — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything, and feel free to spread the word if you get updates too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Quinn — I’ll keep an ear out and share any updates I hear right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How’s the repair drive going so far?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s going steadily so far—mostly a few small fixes and a lot of helping hands. I’m still learning the details one person at a time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — what’s the next thing you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep folks posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep an ear out for updates and pass them along too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Uli — I’m putting the repair drive details in order now. If you’ve got any updates or needed supplies, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I don’t have anything new just yet, but I’ll send you a note if I think of any supplies I need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout already — folks seem glad to pitch in. If you want, I can pass along the details I heard.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s good to hear. Please do pass along the details, and I’ll keep my plans simple and steady.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing — it’s being held over by the community hall, and they’re collecting tools, spare parts, and a few volunteers for sorting. I can swing by with the full list if you want the exact time and drop-off details.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries, Dane — it’s going okay so far. I’m just lining up the tools and we’ll start sorting the repairs soon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good — I can help sort the tools or jump into whatever needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that—what do you need fixed for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just point me to what needs doing, and I’ll do my best not to forget this time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just point me to what needs fixing and I’ll help how I can.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — the main thing is the loose board by the front steps and the flickering porch light. If you can take a look at those, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, I can take a look at the board and porch light.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help however I can with the repair drive—what’s the next thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — could you double-check the repair drive list and tell me what’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll double-check the list and let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m a bit scattered today, but I can help if you tell me what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — we need help sorting donated tools and setting up the repair table. If you can come by around 2, that would be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, 2 works for me — I’ll come by and help sort the tools and set up the table.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Appreciate it, Ira — if you hear of anyone needing a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do, Gus — I’ll pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Could you help sort the donated tools and label the boxes?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated tools and label the boxes. Just point me to where to start.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the timing and where we’re dropping things off first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good question — I’m thinking Saturday morning, and we’d drop everything off at the community center on Maple. Does that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning should work, but I’d like to confirm the exact drop-off time and whether we need help loading the car.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name down or swing by with details?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes please—put my name down and swing by with the details when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll put your name down and stop by with the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — I was thinking Saturday morning, maybe around 9 if that works for folks.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 9 should work for me. I’ll help make sure it fits around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re kicking off the repair drive, Nell. Let’s make a simple list of what needs fixing and who can help.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds good to me, Rosa — I can help keep track of what people tell me and pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Nell — I’ll start the list and you can gather updates from folks on the block. Then we’ll compare notes and see what we can tackle first.
